parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. For more information, see [Multi-application](~~113600~~).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region. By default, data from all regions is returned. You can specify multiple regions separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you leave this parameter empty, data from the last 24 hours is queried by default.
